svg.title: Higher outflows reduce the liquidity coverage ratio
svg.desc: Calculated hypothetical 30-day LCR examples. Eligible HQLA stays 120 million and inflows 60 million. Gross outflows rise from 160 to 220 million, net outflows rise from 100 to 160 million, and LCR falls from 120% to 75%. The ordinary 75% inflow cap is applied.

g.text: Higher outflows reduce the liquidity coverage ratio
Hypothetical 30-day amounts · million currency units · HQLA already eligible
Net outflows = outflows − min(inflows, 75% × outflows). Inflows remain 60.
Inflow caps: 120 in base; 165 with higher outflows. General LCR benchmark: 100%.
